pix_fraud_monthly.licence: Banco Central do Brasil open data terms
pix_fraud_monthly.note: STALE relative to the transaction series: fraud stops at 2026-04 while transactions run to 2026-08. Disputed volume, accepted disputes per 100,000 transactions, and the share of disputed value returned through the special return mechanism. No Indian equivalent is published in machine-readable form. `Database` in the Olinda URL is the EARLIEST reference month, not the publication vintage: each response runs cumulatively forward to the latest published month. Olinda ignores $select, $count, $apply and $orderby, so the full cross-tab is downloaded and aggregated locally. No currency is converted anywhere: every comparison is a share of Brazil's own total.

pix_p2b_initiation.licence: Banco Central do Brasil open data terms
pix_p2b_initiation.note: How the P2B leg is initiated, as a share of that month's P2B volume. BCB began breaking the method out in 2021-06; earlier months carry the code 'Nao disponivel', which is kept rather than dropped so an undisclosed month cannot read as a zero. `Database` in the Olinda URL is the EARLIEST reference month, not the publication vintage: each response runs cumulatively forward to the latest published month. Olinda ignores $select, $count, $apply and $orderby, so the full cross-tab is downloaded and aggregated locally. No currency is converted anywhere: every comparison is a share of Brazil's own total.

pix_txn_monthly.licence: Banco Central do Brasil open data terms
pix_txn_monthly.note: Monthly Pix volume and value by leg, where P2B is person to business and is the leg comparable to India's merchant payments. `Database` in the Olinda URL is the EARLIEST reference month, not the publication vintage: each response runs cumulatively forward to the latest published month. Olinda ignores $select, $count, $apply and $orderby, so the full cross-tab is downloaded and aggregated locally. No currency is converted anywhere: every comparison is a share of Brazil's own total.

psp_financials.note: Filed annual income statements retrieved via the yfinance library, for four listed businesses grouped by what each one sells. A PANEL OF NAMED COMPANIES, not cohort averages: two of the groups hold a single company, and an average of one is not an average. The companies are not like-for-like, so only the shape of the margin each model produces is compared, never a league table.

upi_incentive.coverage: FY2021-22 to FY2024-25, incentive payout and national UPI value split
upi_incentive.note: Hand-transcribed in a browser: PIB serves HTTP 403 to scripted requests, and the figures are published as chart images with printed data labels. The blended rate is incentive paid over ALL merchant value, not the statutory 0.15%, which applies only to transactions at or under Rs 2,000 to small merchants. STALE: the release stops at FY2024-25 and was accessed 2026-09-09.
upi_incentive.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Finance
